done.why: I stopped early after seeing the first few areas and several blocked paths. That is short for a completionist.

about: A Zork-style underground adventure. You come down the Endless Stair for a final test set by a silver-haired old man. You explore dark passages, a shadowy land and an underground sea.

moments.note: The Elvish sword is stuck in the rock and can't be taken.
Walking west into the vegetation turns me back with a mist description, instead of a plain refusal.
The path north along the beach is cut off by surf, with a description that fits the setting.

wished: Find a way through the mist to the vegetation.
Swim past the gap on the beach.

lines.line: until you cannot see the ground you are walking on and have to turn back to find it.
lines.why: A blocked exit described with atmosphere.

lines.line: you would have to swim the gap, and you have seen the surf. Not today.
lines.why: The refusal has a voice and doesn't read as a plain error.

fun.why: Pleasant exploring, but I saw little.

engagement.why: Several locked or blocked leads made me want to come back.

difficulty.why: I didn't get far enough to judge. Several things were blocked.

interestingness.why: The sword in the rock, the mist and the sea are intriguing.

prose.why: Evocative room text and in-voice refusals.
